title: Spicy Stew with Tomatoes
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with a combination of tinned tomatoes and stew meat, seasoned with a hint of Korean chili flakes.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, chili flakes, and soy sauce to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the jiggly jelly (if using) and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions (if desired).
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
